description: Makes an edited copy of one of the user's photos, paid from their credits. type change keeps the pose and framing and changes any of: outfit and place (ids from get_pack of the photo's pack; a place that is a pet or a print, not a scene, is not one to change to), light (one of the four, or the photo's pack's own light from get_pack), the attributes (clothes is an outfit from Change's own list, on any photo; sent with outfit, it wins), and text, up to 300 characters of what to change. type zoom_out steps back one step. Pass the price the user agreed to as max_credits: the photo's prices from get_shoot or list_photos name it. Text is rewritten before anything is made: what Luala doesn't make is left out, a look like a named person becomes that styling, and the result's text is what was sent. Fetch the result with list_photos. If a call to this tool got no answer, it may already have started: check list_photos before calling it again.
name: edit
title: Edit a photo
